fix(codeon): keep daemon alive on provider recovery failures

Dispatch provisioning failures with transient provider conditions
(AuthenticationUnavailable, TemporarilyUnavailable, ProviderRejected,
OutcomeUnknown, ContainmentUnavailable) no longer fail the daemon
closed; they become dispatch outcome-unknown so the operation can be
recovered by an operator attention case.

Startup reconciliation now also adopts dispatch-outcome-unknown
recoveries (AgentDispatchRecoveryRequired /
agent-dispatch:inflight-outcome-unknown) as operator attention, and
attention opening accepts that evidence pair without replacing it.
